title: A PDE approach to the 2D Yang-Mills measure
summary: We introduce the concept of rough additive functions, which extends rough paths theory to line integrals of distributional 1-forms. In the context of gauge theory, we use this notion to define controlled gauge transformations and holonomies via RDEs. One of our main results is a rough version of Uhlenbeck compactness for distributional connections based on rough additive functions. The main ingredient is a singular elliptic PDE to obtain a Coulomb gauge. We solve this PDE using regularity structures and a method inspired by the implicit function theorem.
